Cris Santos Company is a community commercial bank in this vertical, so the GLBA Interagency Guidelines (examined through the FFIEC IT Examination Handbook) bind it directly regardless of size. Research note: For critical financial services (depository institutions and their service providers), examiners assess against the Interagency Guidelines using the FFIEC IT Examination Handbook; with the FFIEC CAT sunset (Aug 31, 2025), the Guidelines plus NIST CSF 2.0/CRI Profile are the natural gap-analysis target. Use Reg SCI for market infrastructure and NYDFS Part 500 for NY-licensed entities. If the bank is New York-chartered, NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 also applies.
